GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Microorganisms ● Types of microorganisms ● Mode of transmission and infections o.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Respiration ● Aerobic and anaerobic respiration ● Respiratory substrates and res.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to General Science ● Importance of General Science, ● Careers in Ge.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations ? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition in Animals ● Chemical and mechanical digestion of foods ● Adaptations .

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Transport in plants ● Absorption of Water and Mineral Salts ● Translocation ● Fa.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on The Periodic Table 2.2 Chemical Families 2.3 Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases a.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Chemical Bonding 2.4 Acids, Bases and Salts 2.5 Rates of Reactions 3.0 Natural P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Chemical bonding ● Bond and bond types ● Bond formation in common compounds and  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Acids, Bases and Salts ● Acids and bases ● Reactions of acids and bases ● Salts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Rates of Reactions 3.0 Natural Physical Science 3.1 Turning Effect of Force 3.2  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
